name: Pinot Noir
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Pinot Noir grape.

name: Cabernet Sauvignon
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Cabernet Sauvignon grape.

name: Bordeaux red blend
definition: Red wine in the Bordeaux style, blended from Cabernet Sauvignon, Merlot, Cabernet Franc and their partners.

name: Sangiovese
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Sangiovese grape.

name: Nebbiolo
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Nebbiolo grape.

name: Syrah
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Syrah grape, under either name.

name: Chardonnay
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Chardonnay grape.

name: Sauvignon Blanc
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Sauvignon Blanc grape.

name: Pinot Grigio
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Pinot Gris grape, under either name.

name: Rosé
definition: still pink wine of any grape, made with brief skin contact or by the methods the rosé class allows.

name: Orange wine
definition: still white-grape wine made with long skin contact, as a red wine is.

name: Champagne
definition: Sparkling wine of the Champagne designation.

name: Cava
definition: Sparkling wine of the Cava designation, made by the traditional method.

name: Prosecco
definition: Sparkling wine of the Prosecco designation.

name: Crémant
definition: Traditional-method sparkling wine of a French Crémant designation.

name: Late-harvest wine
definition: sweet wine made from grapes left on the vine past normal ripeness.

name: Sauternes
definition: Sweet white wine of the Sauternes designation.

name: Tokaj
definition: Sweet wine of the Tokaj designation.

name: Port
definition: Wine of the Port designation, fortified with grape spirit.

name: Sherry
definition: Wine of the Sherry designation, fortified.

name: Madeira
definition: Wine of the Madeira designation, fortified.

name: Vermouth
definition: wine flavoured with wormwood and other botanicals and fortified, sold to drink.

name: Retsina
definition: wine flavoured with pine resin.

name: Quinquina
definition: wine aromatised with cinchona bark.

name: Mixed wine case
definition: mixed case or pack of wines of several kinds, none of which makes up half or more of its volume or weight.

name: American light lager
definition: Very pale, highly carbonated, light-bodied lager of low strength.

name: International pale lager
definition: Pale, clean, well-attenuated lager of standard strength.

name: Czech premium pale lager
definition: Golden Czech lager of ležák strength with a soft malt and Saaz hop character.

name: Munich Helles
definition: Pale, malt-forward Bavarian lager.

name: Czech dark lager
definition: Dark Czech lager with roasted malt character.

name: American wheat beer
definition: Pale beer brewed with a large share of wheat and a clean American yeast.

name: Sorghum beer
definition: traditional beer brewed from sorghum.

name: Millet beer
definition: traditional beer brewed from millet.

name: Alcoholic root beer
definition: Alcoholic beer fermented from roots and their extracts; alcohol-free root beer is not listed here.

name: Banana beer
definition: traditional beer fermented from bananas, often with grain.

name: Mixed beer pack
definition: mixed case or pack of beers of several kinds, none of which makes up half or more of its volume or weight.

name: Common cider
definition: Cider of culinary or table apples, of moderate strength.

name: English cider
definition: Cider in the English style, from bittersweet and bittersharp apples.

name: French cider
definition: Cider in the French style, often keeved, sweet and low in alcohol.

name: Spanish cider
definition: Cider in the Spanish and Basque style, tart and still or lightly sparkling.

name: Perry
definition: Fermented drink of pear juice.

name: Traditional mead
definition: Mead fermented from honey and water with no added fruit or spice.

name: Fruit wine
definition: Wine fermented from a fruit other than grape, apple or pear, such as plum or berry.

name: Junmai sake
definition: sake made only from rice, koji and water, with no brewer's alcohol added.

name: Sake with brewer's alcohol
definition: sake to which brewer's alcohol is added within the legal limit (the ginjo, daiginjo and honjozo types).

name: Nigori sake
definition: sake coarsely filtered so that rice solids stay in it.

name: Makgeolli
definition: Korean milky, lightly sparkling rice wine.

name: Huangjiu
definition: Chinese amber or yellow grain wine and its relatives.

name: Infused rice wine
definition: rice wine infused with fruit, herbs or other flavourings.

name: Single malt whisky
definition: malt whisky distilled at one distillery.

name: Single grain whisky
definition: grain whisky distilled at one distillery.

name: Blended malt whisky
definition: blend of single malt whiskies from more than one distillery.

name: Blended whisky
definition: blend of one or more malt whiskies with one or more grain whiskies.

name: Pot still whisky
definition: whiskey of malted and unmalted barley distilled in pot stills.

name: Bourbon
definition: American whiskey of mainly corn, aged in new charred oak containers.

name: Rye whiskey
definition: whiskey distilled mainly from rye.

name: Corn whisky
definition: whiskey distilled mainly from corn, with no new charred oak ageing required.

name: Cognac
definition: Grape brandy of the Cognac designation.

name: Armagnac
definition: Grape brandy of the Armagnac designation.

name: Calvados
definition: Apple and pear brandy of the Calvados designation.

name: Pisco
definition: Grape brandy of the Pisco designation.

name: Grappa
definition: brandy distilled from grape pomace.

name: Fruit brandy
definition: clear brandy distilled from fermented fruit other than grape wine.

name: Grape brandy
definition: Brandy distilled from grape wine that has no protected name of its own; Brandy de Jerez and other protected brandies are included.

name: Rhum agricole
definition: rum distilled from fresh sugar-cane juice.

name: Cachaça
definition: Brazilian sugar-cane spirit of the Cachaça designation.

name: Molasses rum
definition: Rum distilled from molasses or other sugar-cane by-products, the common rum type.

name: London dry gin
definition: gin distilled with juniper and natural botanicals, with nothing but a little sweetening added after distillation.

name: Tequila
definition: Agave spirit of the Tequila designation.

name: Mezcal
definition: Agave spirit of the Mezcal designation.

name: Vodka
definition: neutral spirit without distinctive character, aroma or taste.

name: Baijiu
definition: Chinese spirit distilled from fermented grain, usually sorghum.

name: Shochu
definition: Japanese spirit distilled from rice, barley, sweet potato or other starch.

name: Soju
definition: Korean spirit distilled from rice or other starch.

name: Awamori
definition: Okinawan spirit distilled from long-grain rice with black koji.

name: Arrack & palm spirit
definition: spirit distilled from palm sap and related bases.

name: Anise spirit
definition: Spirit flavoured mainly with anise (ouzo, pastis, rakı and the like); absinthe has its own entry.

name: Genever
definition: juniper-flavoured spirit made with malt wine.

name: Aquavit
definition: spirit flavoured mainly with caraway or dill.

name: Triple sec & curaçao
definition: orange-peel liqueur.

name: Amaretto
definition: almond-flavoured liqueur.

name: Sloe gin
definition: liqueur of gin flavoured with sloes.

name: Cream liqueur
definition: liqueur made with cream.

name: Fruit liqueur
definition: liqueur flavoured with fruit.

name: Herb & spice liqueur
definition: liqueur flavoured with herbs and spices.

name: Amaro & bitter liqueur
definition: bitter liqueur or drinking bitters sold to drink by the glass (amaro, Fernet and similar).

name: Other ready-to-drink mixes
definition: Sealed mix of a spirit, wine or malt base with a flavouring that none of the other ready-to-drink entries covers.

name: Hard seltzer
definition: sealed carbonated water with alcohol and flavouring.

name: Ready-to-drink cocktail
definition: sealed premixed cocktail, such as canned gin and tonic.

name: Canned spritzer
definition: sealed mix of wine with soda water or a mixer.

name: Radler & shandy
definition: sealed mix of beer with lemonade, fruit soda or juice, sold as radler, shandy or another beer mix.

name: Sotol
definition: spirit distilled from the desert spoon plant (Dasylirion), made and shelved like an agave spirit.

name: Absinthe
definition: spirit flavoured with grand wormwood, green anise and fennel, sold as absinthe (verte or blanche).

name: Nut liqueur
definition: liqueur flavoured mainly with nuts other than the almond of amaretto (hazelnut, walnut and others).

name: Distilled & compound gin
definition: juniper-led gin outside the London dry definition: flavoured, coloured or sweetened after distillation, or compounded.

name: Spiced rum
definition: rum compounded with spices and usually sweetened, sold as spiced rum.

name: Flavoured vodka
definition: vodka compounded with a natural or added flavouring, sold as flavoured vodka.

name: Fruit mead
definition: Mead fermented with fruit.

name: Spice mead
definition: Mead fermented or flavoured with spices or herbs.

name: German Pils
definition: Pale, crisp, hop-bitter German lager.

name: Weissbier
definition: Pale, cloudy German wheat ale with banana and clove yeast character.

name: Witbier
definition: Pale Belgian wheat ale spiced with coriander and orange peel.

name: Märzen
definition: Amber, malty German lager, the Oktoberfest type.

name: Vienna lager
definition: Amber, moderately strong lager with a toasty malt character.

name: Doppelbock
definition: Strong, rich, malty Bavarian lager.

name: Best bitter
definition: Amber British ale of moderate strength with balanced hop bitterness.

name: American pale ale
definition: Pale, hop-forward American ale of standard strength.

name: English IPA
definition: Hoppy, moderately strong pale ale in the English tradition.

name: American IPA
definition: Hop-forward, bitter, moderately strong American pale ale.

name: Hazy IPA
definition: Cloudy, juicy, low-bitterness IPA, the New England type.

name: Double IPA
definition: Strong, intensely hoppy IPA.

name: English porter
definition: Brown to dark British ale with chocolate and caramel malt.

name: American porter
definition: Dark, roasty, hoppier American ale of the porter type.

name: Irish stout
definition: Black, dry, roasty ale of moderate strength.

name: Sweet stout
definition: Dark, sweet stout, often made with lactose, the milk-stout type.

name: Imperial stout
definition: Very strong, intensely roasty and malty stout.

name: Coffee liqueur
definition: liqueur flavoured mainly with coffee.

name: Fruit cider
definition: apple cider fermented or flavoured with other fruit (berry, cherry, citrus and the like).

name: Other sparkling wine
definition: Sparkling wine outside Champagne, Cava, Prosecco and Crémant (Sekt, Lambrusco, Asti and others).

name: Ice wine
definition: sweet wine pressed from grapes frozen on the vine (Eiswein, Icewine).

name: Passito
definition: sweet wine made from grapes dried after picking (passito, vin santo, straw wine).

name: Other fortified wine
definition: Wine fortified with spirit outside Port, Sherry and Madeira (vin doux naturel, Marsala, Rutherglen Muscat and others).

name: Merlot
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Merlot grape.

name: Malbec
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Malbec grape.

name: Zinfandel
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Zinfandel grape, under either name.

name: Tempranillo
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Tempranillo grape.

name: Grenache
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Grenache grape, under either name.

name: Other red blend
definition: still red wine blended from several grapes outside the Bordeaux blend (Rhône, Tuscan and other red blends).

name: Riesling
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Riesling grape.

name: Chenin Blanc
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Chenin Blanc grape.

name: Gewürztraminer
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Gewürztraminer grape.

name: White blend
definition: still white wine blended from several grapes, such as white Bordeaux of Sauvignon Blanc and Sémillon.

name: Everyday sake
definition: ordinary sake outside the eight special designations.

name: Cheongju
definition: Korean clear refined rice wine.

name: Blended grain whisky
definition: blend of single grain whiskies from more than one distillery.

name: Mixed spirits pack
definition: mixed pack of spirits of several kinds, none of which makes up half or more of its volume or weight.

name: Cabernet Franc
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Cabernet Franc grape.

name: Gruner Veltliner
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Gruner Veltliner grape.

name: Semillon
definition: Still dry white wine made mainly from the Semillon grape; sweet Sauternes is listed under dessert wine.

name: Carmenere
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Carmenere grape.

name: Canadian whisky
definition: grain whisky made and aged at least three years in Canada under the Canadian whisky rule, often blended.

name: Wheat whiskey
definition: whiskey distilled mainly from wheat.

name: Sparkling sake
definition: sake carbonated by bottle fermentation or added gas.

name: Munich Dunkel
definition: Dark, malty Bavarian lager.

name: Schwarzbier
definition: Very dark, dry German lager with a restrained roast.

name: Dunkles bock
definition: Strong, dark, malty German lager, the traditional bock.

name: Kolsch
definition: Pale, clean, top-fermented and cold-conditioned ale of Cologne.

name: Sangria & mulled wine
definition: wine flavoured with fruit, spices or herbs and not fortified, sold as sangria, mulled wine and the like.

name: Strong cider
definition: Apple cider of higher strength than the traditional styles.

name: Maize beer
definition: traditional beer brewed from maize.

name: Palm or sap wine
definition: wine fermented from palm or tree sap.

name: Pinotage
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Pinotage grape.

name: Mencía
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Mencía grape.

name: Petit Verdot
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Petit Verdot grape.

name: Tannat
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Tannat grape.

name: Graciano
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Graciano grape.

name: Plavac Mali
definition: still red wine made mainly from the Plavac Mali grape.

name: Verdejo
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Verdejo grape.

name: Albariño
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Albariño grape, under either name.

name: Malvazija Istarska
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Malvazija Istarska (Malvasia Istriana) grape.

name: Furmint
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Furmint grape.

name: Pinot Blanc
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Pinot Blanc grape, under either name.

name: Kerner
definition: still white wine made mainly from the Kerner grape.

name: Blaufränkisch
definition: red wine made mainly from the Blaufränkisch grape.

name: País
definition: red wine made mainly from the País grape.

name: Prokupac
definition: red wine made mainly from the Prokupac grape.

name: Refošk
definition: red wine made mainly from the Refošk grape.

name: Aleksandrouli
definition: red wine made mainly from the Aleksandrouli grape.

name: Altesse
definition: white wine made mainly from the Altesse grape.

name: Kisi
definition: white wine made mainly from the Kisi grape.

name: Albillo Mayor
definition: white wine made mainly from the Albillo Mayor grape.

name: Petite Arvine
definition: white wine made mainly from the Petite Arvine grape.

name: Savagnin
definition: white wine made mainly from the Savagnin grape.

name: Loureiro
definition: white wine made mainly from the Loureiro grape.

name: Friulano
definition: white wine made mainly from the Friulano grape.

name: Falanghina
definition: white wine made mainly from the Falanghina grape.

name: Pecorino
definition: white wine made mainly from the Pecorino grape.
